# Knowledge ingestion

<!-- Generated by tools/docs/api_reference.py from contracts/openapi; do not edit. -->

Base path: `https://<gateway>/ingestion`. Every call needs an API key or a Studio session (see [Authentication](index.md#authentication)). Request and response fields are in the OpenAPI document, `contracts/openapi/ingestion.json`.

| Method | Path | What it does | Body | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/collections` | List Collections |  | 200 list of `CollectionOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/collections` | Create Collection | `CollectionIn` | 201 `CollectionOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/collections/{collection_id}` | Get Collection |  | 200 `CollectionOut` |
| `PATCH` | `/v1/collections/{collection_id}` | Changing the model profile, classification or access groups reindexes the collection. | `CollectionPatch` | 200 `CollectionOut` |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/collections/{collection_id}` | Removes the index, every stored file and the collection. |  | 204 |
| `GET` | `/v1/collections/{collection_id}/documents` | List Documents |  | 200 list of `DocumentOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/collections/{collection_id}/documents` | Upload a file as the raw request body. |  | 202 `UploadOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/collections/{collection_id}/reindex` | Reprocess every document from its stored file (new chunking or embedding model). |  | 202 `RunOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/collections/{collection_id}/runs` | List Runs |  | 200 list of `RunOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/collections/{collection_id}/snippets` | Add (or replace, for the same question) a reviewed answer and sync it at once. | `SnippetIn` | 201 `SnippetOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/collections/{collection_id}/sources` | List Sources |  | 200 list of `SourceOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/collections/{collection_id}/sources` | Create Source | `SourceIn` | 201 `SourceOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/documents/{document_id}` | Get Document |  | 200 `DocumentOut` |
| `PATCH` | `/v1/documents/{document_id}` | Mark a document outdated. | `DocumentPatch` | 200 `DocumentOut` |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/documents/{document_id}` | Removes the document from the index first, then its file. |  | 204 |
| `POST` | `/v1/documents/{document_id}/download-link` | A short-lived link to the original file, for the caller only. |  | 200 `DownloadLink` |
| `GET` | `/v1/downloads/{token}` | Follow a download link. |  | 200 |
| `GET` | `/v1/plugins` | Installed connectors, parsers and chunkers with their configuration schemas. |  | 200 list of `Manifest` |
| `GET` | `/v1/runs/{run_id}` | Get Run |  | 200 `RunOut` |
| `PATCH` | `/v1/sources/{source_id}` | Change a source's settings (e.g. | `SourcePatch` | 200 `SourceOut` |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/sources/{source_id}` | Deletes the source and every document it brought in (index and files). |  | 204 |
| `POST` | `/v1/sources/{source_id}/sync` | Start a sync now; only changed content is re-embedded. |  | 202 `RunOut` |
